decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Gengar. Lead Gengar+Noivern: Noivern Tailwind mirrors their speed control (and Noivern blanks scarf Excadrill's High Horsepower), while Mega Gengar at 200 Spe outspeeds Whimsicott's max 184 and OHKOs it with 4x Sludge Bomb; Shadow Tag then traps their slowed roster. Back two: Incineroar (Intimidate pivot, immune to Zen Headbutt, resists Meteor Mash, threatens Excadrill with Flare Blitz) and Kingambit (hard-walls Metagross and Farigiraf, moves first under enemy Trick Room at 70 Spe
decisions.notebook: Opponent modes: (a) Whimsicott Prankster Tailwind + Mega Metagross/scarf Excadrill offense; (b) Farigiraf+Banette Trick Room (Armor Tail blocks my Fake Out/Sucker Punch AND their own Prankster while Farigiraf is up); (c) Rotom-Wash burn support. Key speed tiers: my Mega Gengar 200, Noivern 192, base Gengar 178; Whimsicott max 184; scarf Excadrill ~231 outspeeds my whole unboosted team — under my Tailwind I outspeed everything except Excadrill under theirs. Type facts: Sludge Bomb is 4x vs Whimsicott (guaranteed OHKO); Kingambit is immune to Farigiraf's Psychic Noise and Metagross's Zen Headbutt, resists Meteor Mash, and at 70 Spe moves before min-72 Farigiraf under TR; Incineroar immune to Zen Headbutt, double-resists Iron Head/Meteor Mash; Noivern immune to High Horsepower (lock Excadrill into it and Noivern walls); Skarmory (benched) also walls Metagross/Excadrill if needed. Plan this series: Mega Gengar + Noivern Tailwind core, Incineroar pivot, Kingambit TR-proof endgame; trade Gengar for Whimsicott if forced — removing their speed control is worth it. Watch Rotom-Wash Will-O-Wisp vs my physical attackers; answer it with Gengar/Noivern special pressure.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Metagross. Lead Whimsicott/Banette establishes Prankster Tailwind and preserves Sash-backed Ghost pressure into Mega Gengar; Banette is not trapped by Shadow Tag. Mega Metagross and Rotom-Wash complete a fast endgame against Incineroar, Noivern, Skarmory, and Kingambit without relying on Intimidate.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 chosen mode: Whimsicott/Banette lead with Mega Metagross and Rotom-Wash back. Preserve Banette as the direct Mega Gengar answer; aim to establish Tailwind before committing Mega Metagross. Avoid feeding Defiant Kingambit an Intimidate cycle; use special Rotom pressure, burns, and positioning instead.

decisions.rationale: Sludge Bomb is a guaranteed OHKO on Whimsicott (160%+ across range), removing their only speed control turn 1. Mega now: 200 Speed should apply immediately to outrun even max-Speed Whimsicott (184) and deny a dying Moonblast, plus Shadow Tag traps Banette (no escape, no Sash save via switching). Knock Off can't OHKO Gengar (max 99.3%) and Gengar resists Moonblast, so Gengar is safe. Noivern (192) naturally outspeeds Whimsicott and sets Tailwind so my whole side outruns everything except scarf Ex

With Whimsicott likely gone early, expect Mega Metagross or scarf Excadrill next — keep Tailwind up and preserve Noivern as Excadrill answer.

decisions.rationale: Prankster Tailwind establishes the speed advantage for the Metagross/Rotom endgame while Shadow Sneak immediately pressures Mega Gengar before it can exploit Shadow Tag. It also avoids relying on Banette surviving Gengar’s super-effective Shadow Ball to use slower Knock Off. A Destiny Bond trade is acceptable for removing the trapping Mega.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 plan remains Whimsicott/Banette lead into Mega Metagross and Rotom-Wash. Preserve the backline’s Tailwind advantage after forcing progress on Mega Gengar; Banette can trade for Gengar if Destiny Bond is used. Avoid Intimidate cycling into Defiant Kingambit.

decisions.rationale: Switch Metagross in: its Steel typing resists both of Noivern’s listed attacks, making it the safest recipient while Banette is likely removed. Rotom-Wash is more valuable held back to pressure Noivern and Incineroar later. Mega Metagross can force Gengar out or finish it once Destiny Bond is managed.
decisions.notebook: Opponent revealed Mega Gengar/Noivern Tailwind lead. Gengar is Timid with Shadow Ball, Sludge Bomb, Destiny Bond, Protect; Noivern is Timid Focus Sash with Tailwind, Hurricane, Draco Meteor, Protect. Preserve Rotom-Wash to answer Noivern and Incineroar. Mega Metagross is intended Mega; respect Destiny Bond before taking Gengar KO. Avoid enabling Defiant Kingambit through unnecessary Intimidate cycling.

decisions.rationale: Gengar at 34% faints to priority Shadow Sneak before acting (Destiny Bond can't beat +1 priority), so pivot to Incineroar: Intimidate drops both physical attackers, and Incineroar is immune to Zen Headbutt while resisting Sneak/Knock Off/Meteor Mash — it hard-walls this duo and threatens STAB SE Flare Blitz on Metagross. Noivern outspeeds both foes and breaks Banette's Focus Sash with Draco Meteor (90% > Hurricane's 70%), so Banette can be KO'd next turn, removing Sneak/Will-O-Wisp utility and c
decisions.notebook: Opponent modes: (a) Whimsicott Prankster Tailwind + Mega Metagross/scarf Excadrill offense; (b) Farigiraf+Banette Trick Room (Armor Tail blocks my Fake Out/Sucker Punch AND their own Prankster while Farigiraf is up); (c) Rotom-W burn support. Key speed tiers: my Mega Gengar 200, Noivern 192; scarf Excadrill ~231 outspeeds my unboosted team. G1 facts: Banette has Focus Sash + Shadow Sneak did 66% to Mega Gengar — Sneak priority KOs Gengar under ~66% BEFORE it moves, so even Destiny Bond fails; Gengar must Protect or switch vs Banette. Mega Gengar Shadow Tag: foes can't switch while it's active. Incineroar walls Metagross+Banette (immune Zen Headbutt, resists Meteor Mash/Sneak/Knock Off, esp. at -1); Flare Blitz is STAB 2x SE on Metagross (~2HKO); Darkest Lariat 2x SE on Banette. Kingambit Kowtow/Sucker 2x SE vs Metagross, immune Psychic Noise/Zen Headbutt, 70 Spe beats min-72 Farigiraf under TR. Noivern immune High Horsepower (walls scarf Excadrill lock; Rock Slide 2x SE is the danger, sash covers). Watch Rotom-W/Banette Will-O-Wisp vs Incineroar/Kingambit. Plan: preserve Noivern as Excadrill answer, Kingambit as TR-proof endgame, Gengar returns once Banette (Sneak) is gone.

decisions.rationale: Shadow Sneak’s +1 priority removes Gengar before it can use Destiny Bond. Mega Ice Punch forces Noivern’s Focus Sash, while Banette’s Focus Sash absorbs its likely retaliation; this leaves both foes cleared or Noivern at 1 HP for Banette’s next Shadow Sneak.

Banette's intact sash guarantees it one action regardless, so double-target it: 1% Noivern (-2 SpA, sash gone) breaks the sash with Draco, Incineroar's Lariat KOs right after Banette acts. This trades a nearly-dead mon for their WoW/Sneak bot, freeing Gengar's return and keeping Kingambit unburned. Fake Out can't hit Ghost Banette; flinching Metagross instead gives Banette a second WoW chance. Incineroar walls Metagross, so its free hit is fine. Only bad branch: Banette Protect-scout.

decisions.rationale: Gengar at 34% is KO'd by Banette's +1-priority Shadow Sneak before acting (did 66% earlier; even -1 KOs), so switching it in is a free faint. Kingambit resists or is immune to every Metagross/Banette attack except Will-O-Wisp and pressures both with 2x SE Kowtow/Sucker. Bring Kingambit, let Incineroar finish Banette, grind Metagross 2v1.

decisions.rationale: Shadow Sneak guarantees removal of the 1% Noivern unless it Protects, while Metagross Protect denies Incineroar’s Fire/Dark pressure and Fake Out disruption. If Noivern protects, Tailwind is still being exhausted and Banette remains positioned to force it again.

Banette moves first regardless, so I can't prevent one last Sneak/WoW; best to guarantee its removal with Lariat (1%, sash consumed) so Gengar is safe later and burns stop. Kowtow (205 Atk, Black Glasses, 2x SE) deals 63-108% to Metagross with no recoil — nearly Flare Blitz damage while keeping Incineroar at 93% to wall Metagross. Metagross is fully walled by both actives (Mash/Ice 0.5x, Zen immune), so even a successful Protect only delays. Parting Shot into Gengar is suicidal vs Sneak.

decisions.rationale: Metagross cannot safely remain in front of Incineroar’s super-effective Flare Blitz, while repeated Protect is unreliable. Pivoting to full-health Rotom preserves Mega Metagross for the endgame; Banette’s guaranteed Protect denies Kingambit’s immediate cleanup and forces the foes to commit into Rotom or make a passive play.
decisions.notebook: Opponent lead mode: Timid Mega Gengar + Timid Focus Sash Noivern Tailwind. Gengar has Shadow Ball, Sludge Bomb, Destiny Bond, Protect; respect Destiny Bond before finishing it. Incineroar is Adamant Sitrus Intimidate with Fake Out, Flare Blitz, Darkest Lariat, Parting Shot. Kingambit is Adamant Black Glasses Defiant with Kowtow Cleave, Iron Head, Sucker Punch, Protect. Preserve Rotom-Wash as primary Incineroar answer; avoid unnecessary Intimidate cycling into Defiant. Mega Metagross remains intended Mega.

decisions.rationale: Banette at 1% must die now to unlock Gengar (Shadow Ball 2x SE + Shadow Tag traps Metagross); Lariat KOs unless its reduced Protect hits. Kowtow into Rotom-W KOs on most rolls from 63% and punishes a Metagross switch (2x SE). Hydro Pump KO risk on Incineroar is acceptable: Kingambit walls Metagross and Gengar cleans once Banette is gone. Fake Out lines leave Banette alive to burn Kingambit and keep Gengar benched.

Calcs: Rotom-W Hydro Pump does 78-135% to Incineroar (can KO; Incineroar has NO Protect — never leave it in vs healthy Rotom-W without a plan). Kingambit Kowtow (Black Glasses) = 48-89% to Rotom-W, 63-108% to Mega Metagross. Incineroar+Kingambit both wall Mega Metagross (immune Zen, resist Mash/Ice Punch) and hit it 2x SE with Dark. Mega Gengar 200 Spe outspeeds Metagross (143-178), Shadow Ball 2x SE, Shadow Tag traps — but dies to any hit; only field it once Banette (Shadow Sneak) is permanently dead. Watch Will-O-Wisp (Rotom-W/Banette) vs my physical core; a burned Kingambit still walls Metagross but Kowtow drops to ~half. Banette's Protect is now reduced-odds. G2 plan: same lead structure works; if they bring Excadrill, keep Kingambit healthy (Sucker Punch neutral) and preserve Gengar for late-game trap.

decisions.rationale: Rotom must not take the guaranteed Kowtow Cleave. Protect preserves the primary Incineroar answer; Banette can still burn Kingambit before being removed if it moves first, sharply improving the Metagross endgame. Even if Banette is KOed or Kingambit Protects, Rotom gets a safe turn and Metagross enters fresh next turn.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Rotom moves before both my Pokemon regardless, so its one action is unavoidable; doubling it guarantees the KO (min 73.2% > 63% HP) unless its reduced-odds Protect succeeds. decisions.rationale: Hydro Pump has the immediate guaranteed-KO range on Incineroar if it connects, preserving Rotom-Wash as the Kingambit answer. Protect denies both Kingambit’s Dark attack and Incineroar’s Fire/Dark pressure into Metagross-Mega; Rotom-Wash should survive a lone Kowtow Cleave from its current HP.

2v1 endgame. Metagross-Mega's entire kit is resisted or immune by both Incineroar and Kingambit, so there's zero risk in doubling up. Flare Blitz (66-112%) + Kowtow Cleave (63-108%) sums to a guaranteed KO through any non-Protect action; even if its reduced-odds Protect succeeds, we repeat next turn at no cost. Kowtow Cleave never misses and outdamages Sucker Punch; no priority needed since nothing threatens us.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Metagross cannot reliably remove either foe immediately and risks being KOed by their combined Dark/Fire pressure. Even at reduced odds, Protect is the only line that can deny both attacks this turn and preserve a route through an opposing misplay or low-damage sequencing.

reflections.summary: Won because the preview plan was right: Incineroar+Kingambit hard-wall Mega Metagross (immune Zen Headbutt, resist Mash/Ice Punch) and both hit it 2x SE with Dark STAB, so they closed a 2v4 after Noivern died. Opponent's Protect-stalling collapsed (Metagross's repeat Protect failed turn 7), and their outs missed — Banette's Will-O-Wisp on Kingambit and Rotom's Hydro Pump on Incineroar. Gengar never needed to field; Noivern contributed nothing (missed Draco Meteor, eaten by Shadow Sneak).
reflections.adjustment: Expect a G2 swap to Excadrill and/or Farigiraf since Metagross was hopeless into the Dark core. Keep the Incineroar+Kingambit backbone but preserve Kingambit's HP for Excadrill (High Horsepower threatens both) and hold Gengar in back as a Shadow Tag trap rather than an early piece. If Farigiraf appears, remember Armor Tail blanks Fake Out/Sucker Punch — lead with Flare Blitz/Kowtow pressure instead. Also consider dropping or better protecting Noivern, whose slot was wasted this game.

Confirmed: Incineroar+Kingambit 2v4 closes vs Metagross/Rotom-W even without support; opponent chains Protect to stall double-targets (repeat Protects fail — punish by doubling the partner) and aims WoW at Kingambit. Incineroar Flare Blitz 66-112% Mega Metagross; resisted Blitz adds 25-46% vs Rotom-W. Mega Gengar (200 Spe) outspeeds Metagross, Shadow Ball 2x SE, Shadow Tag traps; dies to any hit — field only when Banette/Shadow Sneak is gone. Burned Kingambit still walls Metagross. Noivern was low-value in G1 (Draco miss, died to Shadow Sneak) — candidate to swap or shield. G2 plan: same Dark-core backbone; if Excadrill appears keep Kingambit healthy (Sucker Punch neutral) and save Gengar for the late trap; vs Farigiraf avoid priority, use direct attacks.

reflections.summary: Lost because the four/mega plan left Rotom-Wash as the only meaningful answer to Incineroar while Mega Metagross and Banette were poorly positioned into Incineroar plus Kingambit. The missed Will-O-Wisp on Kingambit and Hydro Pump on Incineroar compounded that matchup deficit.
reflections.adjustment: Rework the preview plan: do not default to Mega Metagross into this Incineroar/Kingambit structure; prioritize a four that can pressure both Dark-types without relying on Rotom-Wash alone, and preserve Rotom-Wash for Incineroar.
reflections.notebook: Opponent has shown a Gengar/Noivern lead mode with Incineroar and Kingambit available as a strong physical-Dark backline. Incineroar + Kingambit overloads Rotom-Wash and punishes a Mega Metagross-centric plan; reconsider the intended Mega and bring before game 2. Respect Mega Gengar Destiny Bond and avoid feeding Kingambit Defiant with Intimidate.
